youtube_full.title: Sweet as Honey | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Ezekiel 3:1–3
youtube_full.description:
Sweet as Honey: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Ezekiel 3:1–3.

Heavenly Father showed Ezekiel a vision. A hand reached out, holding a long rolled-up paper called a scroll.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Wren the Wonderer.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Sweet as Honey
1:12 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Wren the Wonderer
1:49 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:00 Question time
3:18 Sweet dreams
3:35 More stories, the app and the paperback
